hypothesis: Daily precipitation-driven conservation states jointly constrained by daily total discharge and a soft hydrograph-separation proxy can improve latent Reach fast/delayed hydrology without a terminal Gauge correction.
objective: station-macro mean squared log1p total-flow error + 0.1 times station-macro standardized delayed-fraction proxy error + Gaussian raw-parameter prior
optimizer: deterministic multi-start scipy L-BFGS-B on five unconstrained raw parameters; Numba float64 state recursion
primary_ET_schedule: uniform within each month with exact prescribed monthly AET closure
observation_support: all strict upstream Reach outflows plus the registered downstream fraction of the station's local Reach
forbidden: terminal Gauge multiplier or station-specific correction
call the separation proxy observed groundwater or old water
